pre_outcome_requirements: record exact downloaded corpus and qrels SHA256 for all three datasets
freeze route order and per-route document/read budgets
freeze query split before scoring any candidate policy
safety_gate: route-aware stopping may not earn success by lowering recall below the prospectively frozen non-inferiority margin; the exact margin must be frozen with the corpus/route manifest before outcomes
denominator_rule: Unavailable registered routes remain in the denominator as unavailable/CANNOT_CHECK; they are not silently removed after outcomes.
stop_rule: No new provider/route, changed depth, changed primary metric, or altered dataset membership after protected retrieval outcomes.
